title: PLAN — SB-061 content display milestone: every emitted entity kind renders, with a coverage list

context.setupNotes: ## What this plan builds The display milestone for SPRINT-002: a third lens page (Playtest) where the loaded case renders every emitted entity kind in its player surface, plus new shared renderers for the kinds that today fall to fallbackJsonSurface, plus a computed coverage list. SB-063 (the playthrough probe) later adds the frontier-traversal loop ON TOP of these surfaces — this plan builds NO verbs, NO predicate evaluation, NO effects, NO day loop. Display only. ## Laws from the map (binding) - SB-058 ruling 1: the lens runs data, never code. Clocks render as DEAD DIALS — labels and both segments visible, needle never moves. - SB-058 ruling 4: no persistence of play state (the existing per-case draft/save seam is editor state and stays). - SB-062 amended ruling 1 + pinned lab rule: wireframes are inspiration only. The lens is a content-edge mapper — it represents the data and its relationships. Never remake the game. - SB-062 ruling 2 (demoted to render inspiration): frank_chat renders in a chat-transcript idiom (question chips, answer lines, followups). calls render in a card-keyed exchange idiom (opening lines, exchanges keyed by card_id). Idiom = layout inspiration for a static display, not interactive structure. - Editor chrome is English; case content and in-game stamps stay Norwegian (FUNN, FAKTUM, SPØRSMÅL, TILTAK). ## Facts the executor needs - CaseSlice (src/compiler/emit.ts:162) entity kinds: documents, facts, questions, hypotheses, tiltak, dispatches, clocks, event_delta_specs, day_script_beats, frank_chat?, frank_proposals?, recipes?, calls? (plus two scalar pair_*_line strings — not entities). - Surfaces exist for fact, document, hypothesis, question (prototypes/shared/surfaces.ts, from SB-082). surfaceFor dispatches on NodeKind; tiltak, dispatch, clock, conversation, recipe, proposal fall to fallbackJsonSurface. day_script_beats and event_delta_specs have NO NodeKind at all — the canvas graph never shows them. Do not add kinds to the NodeKind union unless the canvas genuinely needs them; the Playtest lens may call renderers directly or use its own wider dispatcher. - Renderers are pure (id, CompileResult) -> { title, template } lit TemplateResults. lit escapes by construction — no escape helpers. The node-json pre-wrap rule: interpolation must stay the element's only content. - Document sheets: documentSurface returns Surface.doc; the lens must call wireDocFrame after render (prototypes/shared/doc-frame.ts, scale 'fit' rail / 'full' playtest) and createLightbox once per page. - Case seam: prototypes/shared/active-case.ts owns discovery, ?case= resolution, localStorage keys, wireCaseChrome (picker + cross-links carrying the case). The new page must join this seam. - Lens shell idiom: each probe is its own vite page directory under prototypes/ with plain-anchor lens tabs in the topbar. Canvas and script-editor both ship a dead Playtest (canvas/index.html:1054, script-editor/index.html:535). tsconfig.app.json already includes prototypes/. - SB-082 browser lesson: lit renders AFTER existing children — boot hosts empty, never with a static placeholder div inside a lit-managed host. ## Implementation slices Slice 1 — shared renderers (Task 1). Evidence: focused vitest red-green + full suite. Slice 2 — the Playtest lens page (Task 2). Evidence: real browser screenshot. Slice 3 — the coverage list (Task 3). Evidence: registry-vs-CaseSlice test + screenshot. ## Cautions - Never edit files under .pm/ directly; PM writes go through the pm CLI from the main checkout. - Do not hot-edit while Terje has a lens page open with unsaved work (no-hot-edits law); this plan is AFK build work, keep it to the working tree + commits. - Chrome extension may be offline — fall back to `cmux browser` for the screenshot rung (jsdom misses render bugs).
designDecisions: SB-058: lens runs data never code; clocks are dead dials; no persistence.
SB-062: content-edge mapper, fresh composition; wireframes are per-surface render inspiration only.
SB-062 ruling 2: chat-transcript idiom for frank_chat, card-keyed exchange idiom for calls — as static display here.
SB-061 scope: display milestone only; verbs and traversal belong to SB-063.
Coverage list is computed from the slice type, never hand-maintained.

tasks.title: Task 1: Player-surface renderers for the eight uncovered kinds
tasks.description: Extend prototypes/shared/surfaces.ts (+ surfaces.css, surfaces.test.ts) with pure renderers so tiltak, dispatch, clock, chat conversation, call conversation, recipe, proposal, and day-script beat each render a player-shaped surface instead of fallback JSON. Outcome: clicking any such node in ANY lens shows a readable card, not a JSON dump. Each renderer follows the existing pattern — pure (id, CompileResult) -> Surface, detailPanel/funnCard reuse where it fits, kind stamps in Norwegian (TILTAK etc.), body text straight from the slice. Clock = dead dial: label, question, good/bad segment labels and sizes visible, no needle movement. Chat = transcript idiom: entry question, answer_lines, followups (with tanke sting when present), needs/pays_fact shown as data, not evaluated. Call = card-keyed exchange idiom: opening lines, soft_reject when present, exchanges grouped by card_id with ask + reply lines and their fact_id tags. Dispatch shows title, description, activity/duration/channel meta, and its effects as data lines. Recipe shows the pair, reading, and frank_lines. Proposal shows line, relevant facts/categories, order. Beat shows day, text, effects. surfaceFor (or a wider playtest-facing dispatcher — executor's choice) routes the six NodeKind kinds; beats and any non-NodeKind kinds get direct renderer entry points. Constraint: canvas and script-lens behavior may only change by these kinds now rendering cards — no graph, layout, or NodeKind churn beyond what the routing genuinely needs. fallbackJsonSurface stays, for stubs and future kinds.
steps: Write focused vitest cases first: for each new kind, assert the surface renders the named fields from a minimal CompileResult fixture and does NOT use the fallback label; confirm they fail red against current surfaces.ts.
Implement the renderers and their surfaces.css rules; keep the pre-wrap and lit-escaping conventions.
Route them in the dispatcher(s); run red-green; run the full suite and lint.
tasks.verification: judge: test. command: npx vitest run prototypes/shared/surfaces.test.ts && npm test && npm run lint. proves: every named kind produces player-shaped markup from slice data, escaped by lit, without disturbing the existing four surfaces. fake_evidence: a green suite where a named kind still routes to fallbackJsonSurface (tests must assert the fallback label is absent), or fixture fields the renderer never actually reads.

progressNotes.text: Renderers landed for tiltak, dispatch, clock, chat (chat:frank whole-transcript), call (call:<contact>), recipe (pair-join id), proposal (handbok_id), beat (direct entry, no NodeKind). surfaceFor routes the six NodeKind kinds; beatSurface is a direct export. New Norwegian stamps chosen (no canon existed): HANDLING dispatch, KOBLING recipe, FORSLAG proposal, DAGSSKRIPT beat. Effects/gates render as data lines (.effect-line/.gate-line), never evaluated. Clock = dead dial, .clock-needle asserted absent. Red-green verified + stamped; full suite 339 green; lint clean. Deviation: tests use the real tiny-olsen compile (house style) instead of minimal fixtures — it carries every kind.

tasks.title: Task 2: The Playtest lens page — the loaded case, browsable by kind
tasks.description: New vite page prototypes/playtest/ (index.html + main.ts + page CSS) joining the shared seams: active-case.ts for load/picker/cross-links, the shared surfaces + surfaces.css for rendering, wireDocFrame with scale 'full' plus one lightbox for documents. Outcome: opening /prototypes/playtest/ shows the compiled active case as an entity index grouped by kind (every emitted entity listed with its title/label and count per kind), and selecting any entity renders its player surface in a reading pane at full reading size. Topbar follows the lens idiom: logo, name, case picker, tabs with Script and Canvas as live anchors and Playtest active. Replace the dead Playtest spans in canvas/index.html and script-editor/index.html with live anchors that carry the active case (extend wireCaseChrome if that is where cross-links live). Boot the surface host empty (SB-082 lesson). English chrome, Norwegian content. No verbs, no state, no persistence — a reader, not a game.
steps: Build the page shell on the topbar + two-pane idiom; wire the case seam and the kind-grouped index from the compiled slice.
Wire selection -> surface render -> wireDocFrame('full') + lightbox for documents.
Turn the two dead Playtest spans into case-carrying anchors; add a jsdom smoke test for the page boot (index populated, empty surface rendered).
Eye-check in a real browser: olsen and the stub case, a document sheet, a FUNN card, one of each new Task 1 surface, the lightbox, zero console errors.
tasks.verification: judge: screenshot. command: npm run dev, then claude-in-chrome (or `cmux browser` if the extension is offline) on /prototypes/playtest/ — screenshot the index + a document surface + at least two new-kind surfaces, on both cases via the picker. proves: the lens boots and renders real compiled content in a real browser. fake_evidence: a green jsdom smoke with a blank page live (lit-after-existing-children class of bug), or screenshots of only the four pre-existing surfaces.

progressNotes.text: Playtest lens live at prototypes/playtest/: kind-grouped entity index (13 groups incl. empty ones and event deltas), reading pane with full-scale doc sheets + lightbox, case seam joined (picker, ?case, draft-wins boot, cross-links). Both dead Playtest spans are now live anchors; wireCaseChrome carries the case unchanged. model.ts holds buildIndex + entitySurface (widens surfaceFor with beats + honest event-delta JSON surface); jsdom smoke boots the real main.ts against the page skeleton, red-green stamped. Eye-checked in cmux browser on olsen + stub: index, doc sheet, FUNN, clock, dispatch, chat, call, recipe, lightbox, zero console errors (lit dev-mode warn only). Note: chat rows list each frank_chat entry but all select the shared transcript surface.

tasks.title: Task 3: Computed coverage list — every emitted kind, honest status
tasks.description: A visible coverage panel in the Playtest lens enumerating EVERY CaseSlice entity kind (documents, facts, questions, hypotheses, tiltak, dispatches, clocks, event_delta_specs, day_script_beats, frank_chat, frank_proposals, recipes, calls) with its count in the loaded case and its surface status: player surface, fallback JSON, or no surface yet. The list is computed from a typed registry that the compiler checks against keyof CaseSlice — adding a new emitted kind must fail the typecheck or a test until the registry names it. event_delta_specs and the pair_*_line scalars may honestly carry 'no player surface yet' status; the point is that the list says so, not that everything gets a card. Outcome: Terje opens the lens and reads, in one glance, what of the emitted case still has no player surface.
steps: Define the registry typed against CaseSlice keys; add a vitest case proving an unnamed kind breaks it (type-level assertion or exhaustiveness test), red-green.
Render the panel in the lens from registry + loaded slice counts.
Screenshot the panel on olsen; confirm counts match `npm run case:check` reality.
tasks.verification: judge: test. command: npx vitest run prototypes/playtest/coverage.test.ts (or the file the executor names) && npm run lint, plus a browser screenshot of the panel. proves: the coverage list derives from the slice type and the loaded data, and stays honest when emit.ts grows. fake_evidence: a hand-typed array that happens to match today's CaseSlice, with no exhaustiveness guard.

progressNotes.text: coverage.ts: registry typed as { [K in Exclude<keyof CaseSlice, MetaKey>]: ... } — a new emit.ts kind fails tsc until named; @ts-expect-error negative type tests in coverage.test.ts are judged by npm run lint. Counts derive from the loaded slice (countFor); an honesty test renders each kind's first entity and checks the 'player surface' claim against .node-json reality. Pair_*_line scalars carry 'no player surface yet' rows (count 0/1); event deltas likewise. The lens now BOOTS to the coverage panel (replaces the empty surface — boot smoke updated accordingly). Red-green stamped. Screenshot verified on olsen: 9/25/8/23/9/2/6/3/6/8/23/1/1/2/1 matches the direct compile (case:check itself fails on a pre-existing stale core-loop artifact — issue filed separately).
